title: Addition on the naturals is commutative
statement: For all natural numbers a and b, a + b = b + a.

formal.statement: theorem rado.add_comm : (x0 : AxNat) -> (x1 : AxNat) -> Eq AxNat (rado.add x0 x1) (rado.add x1 x0)

evidence.supports: a + b = b + a for all a b : Nat
evidence.notes: Admitted by axeyum's own Lean kernel via nat_prelude's theorem("add_comm"). The prelude reports zero axioms, so the empty axiom_footprint is measured rather than assumed.
